customManagers.description: The Substrate release that an image builds: the tag and the commit that it names, which Renovate updates together
Pins in ARG lines that follow a renovate comment in the Dockerfiles
Image pins that follow a renovate comment in the integration test files

packageRules.description: A Substrate release is its own pull request and is never merged by Renovate: read the release notes and the result of the patch checks first. It updates the tag and commit of both images, substrate.version and the chart appVersion together.
prBodyNotes: After the merge: publish the install and registration images, set their digests in the consumers, and read the release notes for changes to the patched manifests (see the README, section Upgrade).
